speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. You are a 45-year-old female with daily rectal bleeding for two weeks and a palpable mass, but no pain. Has the bleeding been bright red or dark, and have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as constipation or a feeling of incomplete evacuation?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Rectal bleeding daily with bowel movements. I also have No pain with defecation.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Rectal Carcinoma. The combination of a palpable rectal mass, painless daily rectal bleeding, and a 45-year-old female demographic is highly specific for malignancy until proven otherwise. Please proceed immediately to a colonoscopy with biopsy.
